holybro_m10.source_note: Engineer purchase SoT: Holybro store (https://holybro.com/products/m10-gps) states "Dimension: φ50 x14.4 mm" — circular footprint. Board box uses G1 bounding square 50×50×14.4 (cylinder inscribed in square), disclosed here; not a second invented envelope. HobbyDrone corroboration quoted unlabeled "50 x 50 x 14,4 mm" (same numeric bound). Weight 32g noted but not modeled. Separate 25×25×4mm antenna is a submodule, never folded into this box. M10 V2 is a different product — not this entry. (HobbyDrone: https://www.hobbydrone.cz/gps-module-holybro-m10-gps-module-standard/)
